violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM WAS PRESENT DURING THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS WAS ABLE TO OBTAIN GENERAL MANAGERS CFM INFORMATION BUT PLEASE MAKE SURE TO HAVE A CFM AT FACILITY AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. MULTIPLE SPRAY BOTTLES IN THE KITCHEN AND BAR WERE NOT LABELED WITH THEIR COMMON NAME.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL BOTTLES NEED TO HAVE A LABEL FOR WHAT IS BEING SOTRED INSIDE OF THE . PIC HAD EMPLOYEE BEGIN LABELING ALL BOTTLES BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment which has only non-TCS foods and/or minimally prepares or handles Ready-to-Eat (RTE) food unless it is under the immediate control of a limited certified food manager. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a limited certified food managers certificate. PIC WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE CFM INFORMATION ONCE THEY ARRIVED AT FACILITY. EHS DISCUSSED GETTING MORE EMPLOYEES CERTIFIED BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. FRESH MUSCLES WHERE BEING STORED ON THE COOKLINE WITHOUT THEIR SHELLSTOCK TAGS. PIC COULD NOT PROVIDE THE SHELLSTOCK TAG FOR THAT BATCH OF MUSSELS.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. PIC COULD NOT PROVIDE THE SHELLSTOCK TAGS FOR THE FRESH MUSSELS ON THE COOKLINE AND THREW BATCH OF MUSSELS AWAY. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE CORRECT PROCEDURES FOR KEEPING SHELLSTOCK TAGS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: SALMON, TWO DIFFERENT BURGERS ON THE MENU AND A STEAK.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE MENU ITEMS THAT NEED A CONSUMER ADVISORY. PIC WAS ABLE TO DRAW IN THE ASTRIK NEXT TO THE MENU ITEMS IN NEED OF A CONSUMER ADVISORY AND WILL ADD THE REMINDER AND DISCLOSURE TO EACH MENU.
